name: Chieng Mai duck
summary: Duck from Chiềng Mai, a small bird with yellow skin, fragrant and sweet, soft but not falling apart. It is boiled, steamed, charcoal-grilled, braised with sấu, or cooked with bamboo.
origin: Xã Chiềng Mai, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnam.vn, 2 April 2024.
taste: Vietnam.vn calls the meat fragrant and sweet, soft but not falling apart.
howToEat: In one of the preparations Vietnam.vn names. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Xã Chiềng Mai, huyện Mai Sơn. A shop in the city was not named.
seoTitle: Vit Chieng Mai — duck from Mai Son, Son La
seoDescription: Vịt Chiềng Mai, xã Chiềng Mai, Mai Sơn. Vietnam.vn prints about 1.5–1.7 kg and several preparations.
